posts.author: Pheonix KageDesu
posts.body:
Simple Skills Tree
by Pheonix KageDesu
​
Features:
Create skills trees for classes and allows player select what skill open and learn
You can create many categories (branches) per each class
Visual editor for easy edits skills trees in game (available only in playtest mode)
Supported animated (gifs) skills previews (required VPlayer plugin)
How to Use:
All actual plugin instructions and commands are listed in the plugin help section
Plugin have Demo Projects for MV and MZ
Plugin webpage
(more screenshots and info)
Download:
Demo Project MV + MZ:
Download

Click to expand...
Yes, you can bind Actor's skill points to variable. And just increase this variable by using Item.

posts.author: seikenproductions
posts.body:
Pheonix KageDesu said:
Yes, you can bind Actor's skill points to variable. And just increase this variable by using Item.
Click to expand...
Thanks for the quick reply, but I found the solution on Reddit.  I will post it here in case someone else is searching for the same.
1) Put the following line in the item damage formula to register the targeted actor's ID into the control variable "x":
$gameVariables.setValue(x, $gameParty._targetActorId); 0
(replace "x" with the control variable you wish to use to store the actor's ID)
2) add a common event in the item to trigger it whenever the item is used.
3) In the common event, create a conditional branch "If control variable x = actor ID", then add 1 to
<pSkillPointsVarId:y>, where y is variable where the actor's skill points are stored.
Man...making games are hard...

Ham_Slap said:
What would the Js be for pulling the value for # of skillpoints spent in a particular tree

When player learning a skill, one point is simply taken away from the player. It is not stored anywhere on which skill the skill point was spent. If you need to take this into account, then you can call a common event when learning a skill and start counting there.

Anyway, you are the third person to ask me about this, so in the next update I will add a easy way for integration with VisuStella Main Menu plugin.
